title: feat(ticket-31): scaffold uno-game architecture contract
body: ## Summary - scaffolded `uno-game/` phase-01 structure with `index.html`, `styles.css`, and module boundary stubs (`main.js`, `engine.js`, `ai.js`, `ui.js`) - implemented shared state contract in `uno-game/js/state.js` with AI bounds, phase transitions, and canonical `EVENT_TYPES` - added baseline docs `uno-game/README.md` and `uno-game/RULES.md` - updated `docs/03-core-engine-and-turn-loop.plan.md` to reference canonical `EVENT_TYPES` from `state.js` ## Validation - `node --check uno-game/js/state.js && node --check uno-game/js/main.js && node --check uno-game/js/engine.js && node --check uno-game/js/ai.js && node --check uno-game/js/ui.js` - `node -e "const {MIN_AI_OPPONENTS,MAX_AI_OPPONENTS,isValidAiOpponentCount,canTransitionPhase,GAME_PHASES,EVENT_TYPES}=require('./uno-game/js/state.js'); if(MIN_AI_OPPONENTS!==1||MAX_AI_OPPONENTS!==5) throw new Error('AI bounds mismatch'); if(!isValidAiOpponentCount(1)||!isValidAiOpponentCount(5)||isValidAiOpponentCount(0)||isValidAiOpponentCount(6)) throw new Error('AI range validation mismatch'); if(!canTransitionPhase(GAME_PHASES.MENU,GAME_PHASES.PLAYING)||!canTransitionPhase(GAME_PHASES.PLAYING,GAME_PHASES.ROUND_OVER)||!canTransitionPhase(GAME_PHASES.ROUND_OVER,GAME_PHASES.MENU)||canTransitionPhase(GAME_PHASES.MENU,GAME_PHASES.ROUND_OVER)) throw new Error('Phase transitions mismatch'); const required=['PHASE_CHANGED','TURN_CHANGED','CARD_PLAYED','CARD_DRAWN','WILD_COLOR_CHOSEN','PENALTY_APPLIED','DISCARD_RESHUFFLED','ROUND_WON','ERROR']; for (const key of required){ if(!Object.values(EVENT_TYPES).includes(key)) throw new Error('Missing event type '+key);} console.log('state-contract-check:PASS');"` ## Traceability - Ticket: #31 - Plan: `docs/01-product-rules-and-architecture.plan.md`
